scope: Focused original/source getter comparisons: eight word patterns, six flag/x87 scenarios, four receiver alignments, EAX, stack, non-result integer registers, CPU flags, complete x87 state, no writes and no delegated native execution. Separate inspection confirms all source-compiled seven-byte getter bodies are byte-identical to original MOV/RET bodies. The full regression suite completed for this same executable hash; verification-summary.json records its passing totals.
